params.description: Wallet address (0x hex for EVM, base58 for Solana)

params.name: chain
params.description: Chain filter for `tokens`, `nft`, and `approvals`. When omitted, inferred from address format: 0x addresses query all EVM chains, base58 addresses query Solana.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated sub-resources to include. Valid: `balance`, `tokens`, `labels`, `nft`, `approvals`. The `active_chains` field is always returned. `approvals` is opt-in (not in default) as it triggers additional upstream calls.

Returns a wallet's cross-chain portfolio with selectable sub-resources (balance, tokens, labels, NFTs). Always includes per-chain USD breakdown across 15+ EVM chains.

**Available fields** (via `fields`): `balance`, `tokens`, `labels`, `nft`.

**Lookup:** by `address`. Partial failures return available fields with per-field error info. Returns 422 if `fields` is invalid.

params.name: address
params.description: Wallet address — must be a raw 0x-prefixed hex address, not an ENS name

params.name: chain
params.description: Chain filter. Can be `ethereum`, `polygon`, `bsc`, `avalanche`, `arbitrum`, `optimism`, `fantom`, or `base`.

params.name: limit
params.description: Results per page

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset. This feed is cursor-paginated upstream and only the most recent ~1000 transactions are reachable; a larger offset returns an empty page with meta.empty_reason rather than an error. For deep history prefer the `before` cursor — its upstream cost is bounded by `limit` and independent of depth, whereas a large offset is emulated by walking the whole feed.

params.name: before
params.description: Cursor for efficient deep pagination: return transactions strictly older than this Unix-seconds timestamp (exclusive). Pass the `timestamp` of the last item from the previous page; if items may share a second, pass that timestamp + 1 and de-duplicate on `tx_hash`. Unlike `offset` (which walks the feed), the number of upstream fetches is bounded by `limit` (DeBank returns up to 20 per page) and independent of how far back you page. Mutually exclusive with `offset`.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Field to sort results by. The cursor-paginated upstream feed only supports `timestamp` correctly; unsupported values are rejected by the handler for correctness.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order. The cursor-paginated upstream feed only supports `desc` correctly; unsupported values are rejected by the handler for correctness.

params.name: include
params.description: Comma-separated enrichments to attach to each item. Currently valid: `labels` — adds `from_label` and `to_label` fields with entity information for each counterparty address.

Returns all DeFi protocol positions for a wallet — lending, staking, LP, and farming with token breakdowns and USD values.

**Lookup:** by `address` (EVM only — 0x-prefixed hex). Solana addresses are not supported.

params.name: address
params.description: Wallet address — must be a raw address (0x-prefixed hex for EVM, base58 for Solana). ENS names like `vitalik.eth` are not supported; resolve to a 0x address first.

params.name: chain
params.description: Chain. Can be `ethereum`, `base`, `solana`, `tron`, `bsc`, or `arbitrum`.

params.name: flow
params.description: Filter by transfer direction relative to the queried wallet. `in` for incoming, `out` for outgoing. Omit for both directions.

params.name: token
params.description: Filter by token contract address. Use `0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000` for native token transfers. Omit for all tokens.

params.name: limit
params.description: Results per page. Default 20, max 100. NOTE: Solana (`chain=solana`) is hard-capped at 40 per call by the upstream Solscan API — values above 40 return at most 40 items. Check `meta.has_more` and paginate with `offset` to fetch beyond the first page.

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset. For Solana, this maps to Solscan's 1-indexed `page` parameter (page = offset/page_size + 1).

params.name: include
params.description: Comma-separated enrichments to attach to each transfer. Currently valid: `labels` — adds `from_label` and `to_label` fields with entity information for each counterparty address.

**Included fields:** token contract, token symbol, amount USD, counterparty, flow direction.
